# Polymarket Documentation

> > Developer documentation for Polymarket's decentralized prediction market platform built on Polygon with CLOB orderbook trading and CTF conditional tokens.

Polymarket Documentation provides comprehensive guides for trading, market making, and building on Polymarket's Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) using USDC.e collateral. The platform integrates with Ethereum/Polygon wallets, UMA's Optimistic Oracle for resolution, and offers REST/WebSocket APIs via Gamma API and Relayer Client for programmatic access.

## Key Topics

- CLOB (Central Limit Order Book)
- CTF (Conditional Token Framework)
- USDC.e (bridged USDC on Polygon)
- Gamma API
- Relayer Client
- Prediction markets
- Orderbook trading
- Market makers
- Price discovery
- Token splitting and merging
- Bridge API
- WebSocket real-time data
- UMA Optimistic Oracle
- Builder program
- Non-custodial wallets

## Trading & Core Concepts

- [Trading Overview](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/overview): CLOB trading architecture, authentication, and non-custodial wallet setup
- [Prices & Orderbook](https://docs.polymarket.com/concepts/prices-orderbook): CLOB price discovery, limit/market orders, and bid-ask spread mechanics
- [Split Tokens](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/ctf/split): Convert USDC.e to outcome token pairs via CTF contract on Polygon

## Market Makers

- [Market Maker Overview](https://docs.polymarket.com/market-makers/overview): Market making guide covering liquidity, CLOB/Gamma APIs, and USDC.e setup

## API Reference

- [Get Market by Slug](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/markets/get-market-by-slug): Gamma API: fetch market data using slug identifier
- [Get Last Trade Price](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/market-data/get-last-trade-price): Market data API: fetch last trade price and side by token ID
- [Get Builder Trades](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/trade/get-builder-trades): Trade API: retrieve originated trades for authenticated builders
- [Get Current Nonce for a User](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/relayer/get-current-nonce-for-a-user): Relayer API: retrieve Proxy/Safe nonce by Ethereum signer address
- [Get All Relayer API Keys](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/relayer-api-keys/get-all-relayer-api-keys): Relayer API: retrieve all API keys for authenticated Ethereum address
- [Get Server Time](https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/data/get-server-time): CLOB API: get Unix timestamp for client-server time synchronization

## Bridge & Deposits

- [Deposit Status](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/bridge/status): Bridge API endpoint for tracking cross-chain deposit progress
- [Supported Assets](https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/bridge/supported-assets): Bridge API: supported chains, tokens, and minimum deposit requirements

## 中文文档 (Chinese Documentation)

- [构建者计划 (Builder Program)](https://docs.polymarket.com/cn/builders/overview): Chinese: Builder program for order routing, revenue sharing, and CLOB integration
- [市场与事件 (Markets & Events)](https://docs.polymarket.com/cn/concepts/markets-events): Chinese: Binary markets, ERC1155 tokens, and multi-outcome events explained
- [价格与订单簿 (Prices & Orderbook)](https://docs.polymarket.com/cn/concepts/prices-orderbook): Chinese: CLOB pricing mechanics and peer-to-peer trading explained
- [判定 (Resolution)](https://docs.polymarket.com/cn/concepts/resolution): Chinese: UMA Optimistic Oracle resolution and token redemption process
- [订单归因 (Order Attribution)](https://docs.polymarket.com/cn/trading/orders/attribution): Chinese: Attribute orders to Builder API keys for volume credits
- [库存管理 (Inventory Management)](https://docs.polymarket.com/cn/market-makers/inventory): Chinese: CTF token splitting, merging, and USDC.e inventory management
- [合并代币 (Merge Tokens)](https://docs.polymarket.com/cn/trading/ctf/merge): Chinese: Merge outcome token pairs back to USDC.e collateral
- [Market 频道 (Market Channel)](https://docs.polymarket.com/cn/market-data/websocket/market-channel): Chinese: WebSocket API for real-time Level 2 orderbook and trade updates
